tickets.title: Follow up on account security concern
tickets.text:
Security concern type: unauthorized access
Affected account or platform: Velvet Acorn Custody
Date client reported concern: 2025-11-06
Client's preferred contact method: secure portal messages or phone calls
Immediate action requested: custodian escalation, credential reset coordination, evidence documentation, phone update
Custodian or platform contact: Velvet Acorn Custody
Evidence to review: Paige’s forwarded login alert for a session she did not recognize and her statement that she could not verify whether recent account activity was legitimate
Resolution status: open
Next client update: by 2025-11-07
Internal notes: 
Paige Lanternmoss reported an unrecognized login alert on her Velvet Acorn Custody account and could not verify recent activity. The follow-up includes custodian escalation, credential reset coordination, evidence documentation, and a phone update to Paige by 2025-11-07.
tickets.evidence: They agreed on follow-up by 2025-11-07 covering custodian escalation, evidence documentation, credential reset coordination, and a phone update to Paige.

tickets.title: Track custodian transfer status
tickets.text: Check the pending transfer with the receiving custodian, note the latest status, and alert the advisor if assets, cost basis, or residual cash have not arrived as expected. Check the Velvet Acorn Custody transfer tracker for the taxable account move from Teacup Comet Brokerage.
